prompt: Make these calls sequentially: inspect-listeners, exactly one play-session-and-listen for the supplied MIDI Session target with durationBeats 1, maximumDurationMs 30000 and only the supplied listener ID, then get-pass once with the returned passId. The runner explicitly requests level, spectral-centroid and attacks; spectral timing is deliberately unestablished and must be reported as unavailable. Use only the new v5 independent-metric pipeline. If a call fails, stop and report it: do not retry, repair, seek, stop playback, change settings, edit the Set or use another listener. After the first get-pass, if it is nonterminal, immediately finish your turn with pending. Never call get-pass twice, poll or wait: the harness owns the terminal wait. Only after completed or partial may you get the context with includeHistorical=true. Leave playback running. Report measured level and attack availability without inventing frequency information or claiming exclusive clip audio.
